front: This is Stamp’s post office. Read your post, write letters, send postcards, or sort mail for Stamp.
title: Your Mailbox
empty: No letters in your mailbox yet.
noaddress: Post needs an address. Put a name on your homestead’s sign first.
shut: The post counter is closed right now.
reported: The letter is gone from your mailbox. Someone will check it.
nopass: Your letter can’t go yet: save your pass first. What you wrote is kept.

drawers.none: No new letters. Letters you have opened are in Kept.

knock.about: You haven’t had a letter from this banana before. Open it, and their next letters come straight in.
knock.gone: Sent back. That house can’t send you letters again.

round.on: A tray of post is on the counter, with the pigeonholes open behind it.
round.far: Walk right up to the post office counter, then try again.
round.hint: Each card goes in the pigeonhole with the same picture.

receipt.title: Sorting Receipt
receipt.take: {n} of {of} cards went straight to their holes.
receipt.counted: This round counts toward the week’s sorting.
receipt.short: Under half the cards reached the right hole, so this round does not count.

round.parcel: A parcel: sort it, then tap it on the scale.
round.registered: A red seal: registered post. Sort it at once.

card.title: Picture Postcard
lines: This made me think of you.
I picked this spot on purpose.
card.sent: The postcard joins the outgoing mail.

folk.title: Neighbours’ Houses
folk.none: That name or house name is not in the book.
